description: Before you open, log in to or connect a wallet to a website or link: whether it's on MetaMask's open phishing list (what wallets use to block drainer sites), whether its name imitates a well-known brand (one letter off, the brand's name on another ending, the brand's name with words added, or punycode lookalike letters), when the domain was registered (RDAP), when the Wayback Machine first archived it, and whether it resolves. Read from public records, never by visiting the site. Verdict: high risk, caution or no warnings, with reasons; not being flagged doesn't make a site safe. Use for 'is this site legit?', 'is this link a scam?', 'is this the real Uniswap?'.

url.description: The website or link, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/claim

name: site_check
title: Is this website legit?
